items.html: *And however, the fact that there are two breasts in the male and both of them in the female is in accord with what was said above: when the NHY of Arich rose and were included with his HGT, the Netzah was included from the Hod and the Hod from the Netzah as well, as is known, for the NH are always beloved companions, included one in the other.
